name: HACCP Process Flow Chart Template & Diagram
search_intent: Catering businesses, food processors, and food safety managers creating the required Step 4 / Principle 1 process flow diagram for their HACCP manual, identifying where biological, chemical, physical, and allergen hazards occur and which steps are Critical Control Points (CCPs).

competitors.title: HACCP Flow Chart: Complete Guide & Examples | FoodDocs
competitors.strengths: Clear diagrams explaining linear catering steps.
competitors.weaknesses: Aggressive sales funnel requiring paid subscription or trial signup to download or edit.

competitors.title: HACCP Flow Chart Guide & Free Templates | SafetyCulture
competitors.weaknesses: Gated download requiring mobile app installation and email registration.

competitors.title: How to Create a HACCP Flow Chart | High Speed Training
competitors.weaknesses: Static blog article designed to sell Level 3 HACCP training courses, no interactive builder.

competitors.title: HACCP Flowcharting Best Practice | Campden BRI
competitors.weaknesses: Dense industrial consultancy text, no catering-level interactive diagram or free tool.

competitors.title: HACCP Process Flow Diagram Software | Safe Food Pro
competitors.weaknesses: Demo request paywall, zero public utility without sales call.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: Paywalled software trials, course marketing posts, or static diagram images.
gap_analysis.what_they_lack: An ungated, interactive browser flow chart diagram mapping sequential steps from goods receiving to service, complete with hazard identification, CCP classification, critical limits, and instant print layout.
gap_analysis.what_we_offer: Fully interactive step-by-step HACCP diagram tool with expandable hazards, statutory critical limits, monitoring protocols, corrective action SOPs, and one-click PDF generation.
